title: Maestro Collection
body_html: Collection that unveils the entire universe of Wagyu, where the classic meets the extraordinary in a captivating exploration through our exceptional offerings.

title: Epicurean Collection
body_html: Collection that effortlessly guides any cooking method to the pinnacle of joy, making every recipe a delightful masterpiece

title: Primordial Collection
body_html: Collection that preserves the primal taste of unprecedented textures, a feast of sensations never experienced before

title: Top Round
body_html: One of the most tender hind-leg cuts, offering a lean texture and mild, clean beef flavor.

title: Abomasum
body_html: Chewy and deeply savory, abomasum delivers a rich, nutty flavor and a satisfying offal character.

title: Tail
body_html: Discover the deep, savory richness of Japanese Wagyu tail. Slow cooking transforms its collagen-rich meat into an exceptionally tender texture and a broth of remarkable depth.

title: Large Intestine
body_html: Generous exterior fat gives large intestine its signature richness, deep savoriness, and full-bodied flavor.

title: Mountain Chain Tripe
body_html: Chewy, springy, and clean-tasting, this tripe cut offers a distinctive texture and subtle savory flavor.

title: Small Intenstine
body_html: Small intestine is prized for its chewy texture, rich juiciness, and deeply savory flavor when grilled.

title: Tongue
body_html: Distinctive in texture, beef tongue offers a tender, springy bite and a uniquely deep, savory flavor.

title: Chuck Eye Log
body_html: A hearty cut with a firm grain, abundant juiciness, and a deep beef flavor that grows richer with every bite.

title: Chuck Cap
body_html: Firm texture and moderate fat make this a satisfying, full-flavored cut ideal for barbecue and grilling.

title: Oyster Blade
body_html: Deep color, ample juiciness, and a clean yet lingering beef flavor define this distinctive cut.

title: Tri Chuck
body_html: Rib-like succulence, a pleasantly chewy texture, and rich savory flavor make this cut especially satisfying.

title: Clod Heart
body_html: Lean yet juicy, this cut offers a firm bite and a concentrated expression of pure beef flavor.

title: Upper Oyster Blade
body_html: Juicy and deeply savory, this leaner cut delivers clean beef flavor with a pleasantly firm texture.

title: Chuck Tender
body_html: Deeply colored with a firm, chewy texture and bold beef aroma, this cut is especially well suited for tartare.

title: Heel
body_html: Rich in connective tissue, this cut develops a deeply savory flavor and pleasantly gelatinous texture with slow cooking.

title: Digital Muscle
body_html: Lean but juicy, this cut offers a firm, chewy texture and a robust, deeply beefy flavor.

title: Conical Meat
body_html: Low in connective tissue, this cut is clean, lean, and pleasantly chewy with a pure beef flavor.

title: Tenderloin Head
body_html: The head section of the tenderloin, prized for its exceptional tenderness and delicate, clean flavor.

title: Tenderloin Wing
body_html: Lean and delicate, this cut showcases the tenderloin’s soft texture and pure, understated beef flavor.

title: Tenderloin Sidestrap
body_html: Low in intramuscular fat, this cut is lean, tender, and clean-tasting with a subtle beef aroma.

title: Rib Cap
body_html: Fine-grained tenderness, abundant juiciness, and rich marbling come together in a deeply flavorful cut.

title: Ribeye Sidestrap
body_html: Tender and juicy with a savory beef aroma, this cut delivers a smooth, richly satisfying flavor.

title: Striploin Sidestrap
body_html: Exceptionally tender and juicy, this cut offers a delicate beef aroma and a smooth, savory finish.

title: Head Rib
body_html: Firm muscle fibers, rich juiciness, and generous marbling create a bold beef flavor and satisfying bite.

title: Rib Finger
body_html: Chewy, savory, and deeply aromatic, this cut delivers concentrated flavor in every bite.

title: Flap Meat
body_html: A tender, pleasantly chewy cut with subtle sweetness and a rich, deeply savory finish.

title: Flap Meat Cap
body_html: Coarse-grained and generously marbled, this cut is juicy and full of the deep, savory character of brisket.

title: Rib Plate
body_html: Remarkably chewy and distinctive in flavor, this cut is also ideal for producing a rich, deeply savory broth.

title: Outside Skirt
body_html: Firm-grained, juicy, and lightly marbled, this cut delivers bold beef flavor and a deeply satisfying chew.

title: Hanging Tender
body_html: Distinctive and intensely beefy, this juicy cut develops a deeper, more savory flavor with every bite.

title: Flank Steak
body_html: Coarse-grained yet juicy, this cut offers a chewy texture and a deep, robust beef flavor.

title: Short Plate
body_html: Layers of meat and fat create exceptional juiciness, rich savory flavor, and a satisfyingly hearty texture.

title: Inside Skirt
body_html: Fat woven through the grain creates generous marbling, abundant juiciness, and a bold, full-bodied flavor.

title: Bottom Round
body_html: Fine-grained and lean, this cut offers a tender texture and a clean, delicate beef flavor.

title: Eye of Round
body_html: Lean, juicy, and evenly grained, this cut is ideal for dishes that highlight its naturally shreddable texture.

title: Top Round Cap
body_html: Very lean and clean-tasting, this cut is especially suited to preparations that highlight pure beef flavor, such as tartare.

title: Top Sirloin Butt
body_html: Deep red in color and intensely beefy, this cut is prized for its rich aroma and full, savory flavor.

title: Culotte Head
body_html: Fine-grained and well marbled, this cut is tender, juicy, and richly savory.

title: Culotte Body
body_html: Deeply colored with a coarse grain and firm texture, this cut offers a bold expression of pure beef flavor.

title: Main Knuckle
body_html: Lean and protein-rich, this cut delivers a firm texture and an especially concentrated beef aroma.

title: Inside Knuckle
body_html: The most marbled knuckle cut, offering tenderness, rich beef aroma, and excellent steak potential.

title: Outside Knuckle
body_html: Low in connective tissue, this tender, deeply flavored cut is equally suited to tartare or grilling.

title: Tri Tip
body_html: Abundant juiciness and evenly distributed marbling create a balanced texture and outstanding flavor.

title: Omasum
body_html: Lean and delicately layered, omasum is prized for its springy, crisp, and highly distinctive texture.

title: Filet Mignon
body_html: The most tender portion of the tenderloin, offering a delicate texture and exceptionally clean, refined flavor.

title: Ribeye Center
body_html: Intense juiciness, deep beef flavor, and a rich savory finish make this one of the most celebrated cuts.

title: Chateaubriand
body_html: Cut from the center of the tenderloin, it offers exceptional tenderness with added richness and juiciness.

title: Striploin
body_html: Striploin features fine marbling woven between the muscle fibers, creating a balanced harmony of tender texture, rich juiciness, and savory depth.

title: Ribeye Cap
body_html: Delicate muscle fibers and generous marbling create exceptional tenderness, richness, and savory depth.

title: Tri Rib
body_html: Relatively lean yet full of character, this cut delivers concentrated beef flavor and a deep savory aroma.

title: Brisket Point
body_html: Layers of meat and fat create a succulent, richly savory cut with a satisfyingly dense texture.

title: Brisket
body_html: Lean, firm, and intensely beefy, this cut is especially prized for creating rich, full-bodied broths.

title: Chuck Short Rib
body_html: Generous marbling creates a balance of tenderness and chew, with rich juiciness and a savory beef finish.

title: Chuck Flap Tail
body_html: Exceptional marbling, tender texture, and abundant juiciness come together in a deeply savory, richly flavored cut.
